title: Invisible stalkers
content:
Strange invisible assailants with form and substance. 
*The Nothing ([[04.31]]) seems to have created invisible stalkers ([[03.31]]) in the Old Mill. The shamans say that they are souls regurgitated by the Nothing. 
**An intruder to the mill would see only six-toed footprints approaching through the powder before being slain.
*Attu of [[Bones' Jangle]] suspects that his cabaret is haunted, but rather than a restless spirit he has an invisible stalker controlled by [[Imorcar]] and kept in a brass hookah. Imorcar releases it when he wants to eliminate a perceived threat.
